'''August 2004 Vancouver, Washington tournament''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG local tournament held on Saturday 7 August 2004 at NetGamerZ, 10311 NE Fourth Plain Blvd, Vancouver, Washington, run by [[Edward Fones]].<ref name="pcf-3659-49965">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=49965#49965 Vancouver, WA, August 7th], Edward Fones (ecf), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (17 July 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040908230924/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=3659%26amp Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-3781-51715">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=51715#51715 Anyone know about a tourney on the 31st in Oregon? ECF????], David Kangas (Shadow 31), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (31 July 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040908230957/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=3781%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> It was an open-format event starting at 1:30 pm, with a $2.50 entry fee and prizes for every player; players were asked to bring their Decipher ID numbers. Fones billed it as a last chance to test ideas in an open tournament before Gen Con, a few weeks later.<ref name="pcf-3659-49965" /> [[David Kangas]] confirmed the date and venue a week before and planned to play his "Fugitive" deck there before Gen Con.<ref name="pcf-3781-51715" />

* '''Format:''' open<ref name="pcf-3659-49965" />
